verdict.rationale: Trigger.dev is a workflow and background-task platform, so a community connector ecosystem is a fair question to ask of it. However, the evidence pack documents no way to install community-built integrations, nodes, or components contributed outside the vendor. Build extensions are a first-party hook into the build process, which is a developer building block rather than a community integration ecosystem, so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As a developer, I can install community-built nodes, components, or integrations contributed outside the vendor
